cells.gaps: No source found of a law on sending personal data abroad, or of a ratification of the Malabo Convention.
cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): A source of 19 July 2026 says no statute governs cross-border transfer of data [SDN-001], which sets stage 1. No transfer rule is held, so questions 2 and 3 are unanswered. Signature of the Malabo Convention [SDN-003] is not a ratification.
